chunks: Everything in this book that is narrated from Al-Hasan ibn 'Ali al-Washsha' has been transmitted by me from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan—may Allah be pleased with him—from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn 'Isa and Ibrahim ibn Hashim together, from Al-Hasan ibn 'Ali al-Washsha', known as Ibn Bint Ilyas.
ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Al-Hasan ibn 'Ali al-Washsha' in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Al-Hasan ibn 'Ali al-Washsha'. It serves as a chain-authentication note in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih, identifying the intermediaries and preserving the transmission lineage.
